headline: CISA's four-flaw KEV batch leads a day of active exploitation and third-party trust failures
standfirst: CISA added four actively exploited flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and separately listed a SonicWall SSLVPN bypass, while exploitation also hit QNAP NAS devices and Keplr wallets. France attributed disruptive retail refrigeration attacks to Iranian state-backed hackers, N-able pulled hosted N-central offline over published alleged zero-days, and researchers described an AI-agent intrusion into Taipei dispatch records.
bodyMarkdown:
## Actively exploited

CISA added four flaws to KEV on evidence of active exploitation: GPUStack improper authentication (CVE-2026-102895, 9.8 Critical), FreeSWITCH code injection (CVE-2026-116779, 9.8 Critical), OpenSSH password authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123158, 8.1 High) and IBM Aspera Faspex incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-123218, 9.8 Critical) [[s32]]. Three are Critical, but the set is mixed, not uniformly so. GPUStack before 2.2.0 let unauthenticated remote requests gain administrator access by appearing to come from loopback; exploitation was observed against a 2.1.1 deployment. FreeSWITCH before 1.11.3 let a peer whose SIP MESSAGE was accepted reach API command execution; exploitation was observed. OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux with musl libc and no PAM can accept any 256–1024-character password for some account configurations. Aspera Faspex 5.0.0–5.0.19 lets an authorized user craft a message to gain full administrative privileges. CISA's federal remediation deadline applies to federal agencies, not every organization.

CISA also listed CVE-2026-19868, a 7.5 High SonicOS SSLVPN authentication-enforcement flaw, after reports it may have been exploited [[s42]]. A user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method can bypass SAML controls and SAML-enforced MFA; affected SonicOS is before 7.3.4-7015.

Plex2Shell, a four-flaw chain against Plex Media Server on QNAP NAS devices, is being exploited, although the excerpt supplies no CVE IDs, affected versions or patch details [[s27]].

Some Keplr wallets created with Google or Apple sign-in were drained after an attacker exploited a Web3Auth flaw; Web3Auth then used the attacker's route to empty other at-risk wallets, the companies said [[s35]]. The flaw and affected configurations were not supplied.

## Industry

France has linked cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration at more than 700 supermarkets and other retail locations to Iranian state-backed hackers, saying the attacks caused food losses and sparked at least 15 fires [[s9]]. The attribution is France's, and the excerpt does not detail the intrusion path. Analysis: the reported fires make this a safety story as much as an availability one, but the supplied text does not explain how the cyber operation led to ignition.

## Vulnerabilities

N-able took hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down servers after a researcher published more than 30 alleged zero-days, including exploit code that could let attackers take over systems [[s2]]. The excerpt does not list the flaws, affected versions or evidence of exploitation. Analysis: for MSPs, hosted N-central is shared operational plumbing, so the defensive action is disruptive; the claims remain alleged and unverified here.

## Breaches

An attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers, stealing stored secrets and data, according to Wiz [[s12]]. The attacker used credentials for an AWS account that Qubole's platform uses to reach customers; how those credentials were obtained has not been disclosed. Qubole is a data lake platform owned by Idera. The excerpt does not give customer counts, data types or notification status. Analysis: this is a third-party trust failure, with Qubole's cross-account access as the path, but initial access remains unknown.

## Research

Acronis researchers say a single attacker using AI agents pulled emergency dispatch records covering seven Taipei districts and found a Taipei fire department platform exposing historical patient data, including ECG readings and ambulance video, without a login [[s38]]. They are highly confident the attacker is one person. The excerpt does not describe the agent tooling or whether the exposed platform was compromised or merely accessed. Analysis: the notable element is operational tempo—agents finding and aggregating exposed data—not a newly described exploit.

kev.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). nvd.description: GPUStack is an open-source GPU cluster manager for AI model serving and GPU instance provisioning. Prior to 2.2.0, get_current_user in gpustack/api/auth.py treated a loopback request source as the built-in administrator when force_auth_localhost was false, which was the default. A remote request could appear to originate from 127.0.0.1 because client_ip_getter accepted a same-host reverse proxy peer or a client-supplied X-GPUStack-Real-IP loopback value. The bypass allowed unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml. Exploitation was observed in the wild against a 2.1.1 deployment. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.0.

nvd.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.3, sofia_presence_handle_sip_i_message() split the To user of an inbound SIP MESSAGE on a plus sign and treated the left side as a chat protocol selector. Selecting the api chat proto reached switch_api_execute(), allowing a peer whose MESSAGE was accepted to run FreeSWITCH API commands, including operating-system command sinks, with the daemon's privileges. Inbound chat is enabled on the stock internal and external profiles, and any authenticated profile account is sufficient; stock directory users without password material can also remove that barrier in affected configurations. The flaw permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution, and exploitation has been observed in the wild. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.3.
